# GameSky.space — Retro DOS Workstation for macOS

> GameSky.space is an open-source, native macOS retro computing workstation and DOS game manager built with Rust 2021 and Tauri v2. It provides 1-click execution for classic MS-DOS games with zero manual configuration, EMS/XMS memory management, multi-engine emulation switching (DOSBox 0.74-3, DOSBox-Staging, DOSBox-X), Drive Bay ISO/Floppy mount, authentic Sound Blaster 16 & MT-32 audio, and 35 pre-curated FreeDOS titles.

## Core Capabilities
- **1-Click Game Launch**: No typing `mount c ~/games/doom`, no EMS memory crashes, no 8.3 filename collisions on APFS/macOS.
- **Multi-Engine Switching**: Seamlessly switch between official DOSBox 0.74-3, modern DOSBox-Staging, and advanced DOSBox-X (including 3dfx Voodoo Glide emulation).
- **Drive Bay**: 1-click mounting of CD-ROM ISO/BIN+CUE disk images and Floppy .IMG/.IMA images with multi-disc swap support.
- **Hardware Lab Emulation**: Accurate Sound Blaster 16, OPL3 FM synthesis, Gravis UltraSound, Roland MT-32 MIDI, and CRT retro shaders.
- **Modern macOS Integration**: Apple Silicon native (M1, M2, M3, M4) & Intel 64-bit universal binary, macOS 10.15+ (Catalina, Big Sur, Monterey, Ventura, Sonoma, Sequoia).
- **100% Offline & Private**: Zero telemetry, no cloud required, 100% local execution.
- **License**: MIT Open Source License.
